license_required.quote: Nothing in this act shall authorize the practice of medicine and surgery by any person not licensed so to do pursuant to chapter 9 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Consumer Affairs, Department of Law and Public Safety
umbrella_agency.quote: Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety

degree_required.value: diploma from a legally incorporated professional school or college of medicine and surgery
degree_required.quote: a diploma from some legally incorporated professional school or college of the United States, Canada or other foreign country, which school or college, in the opinion of the board, was in good standing at the time of the issuance of the diploma, or (b) a license conferring the full right to practice all of the branches of medicine and surgery in some foreign country

required.quote: after receiving his diploma, he has completed and received academic credit for at least two years of post-graduate training in an accredited program and has signed a contract for a third year of post-graduate training in an accredited program

duration.value: at least two years of post-graduate training with contract for third year
duration.quote: at least two years of post-graduate training in an accredited program and has signed a contract for a third year of post-graduate training in an accredited program

kind.quote: post-graduate training in an accredited program

exams.name: Medical licensing examination
exams.quote: admission to licensure by examination to practice medicine and surgery

interval_years.quote: All persons who are licensed to practice medicine and surgery shall be required on or before July 1 biennially to register

required.quote: The State Board of Medical Examiners shall require that the number of credits of continuing medical education required of each person licensed as a physician who provides perinatal treatment and care to pregnant persons, as a condition of biennial registration

value: one credit of educational programs or topics concerning explicit and implicit bias for physicians providing perinatal treatment
topical_requirements.quote: include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning explicit and implicit bias

available.quote: a board shall issue a professional or occupational license, certificate of registration, or certification to any person who documents that the person holds a valid, current corresponding professional or occupational license, certificate of registration, or certification in good standing issued by another state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold valid license in good standing from another state with substantially equivalent education, training, and examination requirements; must have been practicing within five years prior to application; must pass criminal history background check if required
requirements.quote: the state that issued the license has, or had at the time of issuance, education, training, and examination requirements for licensure, registration, or certification substantially equivalent to the current standards of this State, as determined by the board or committee; (2) the applicant had been practicing in the profession for which licensure in this State is sought, within the five years prior to the date of the application

national_association.value: American Board of Medical Specialties, American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: certification by a single specialty board recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialties or the American Osteopathic Association or another certification entity with comparable standards that is acceptable to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained license through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a certificate, registration, license or authorization to sit for an examination, as the case may be, through fraud, deception, or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in the use or employment of dishonesty, fraud, deception, misrepresentation, false promise or false pretense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence that damaged or endangered life, health, welfare, safety or property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in gross negligence, gross malpractice or gross incompetence which damaged or endangered the life, health, welfare, safety or property of any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in repeated acts of negligence, malpractice or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in professional or occupational misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in professional or occupational misconduct as may be determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or engaged in acts constituting a crime with direct or substantial relationship to regulated activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of, or engaged in acts constituting, any crime or offense that has a direct or substantial relationship to the activity regulated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had authority to practice revoked or suspended by another state for reasons consistent with disciplinary grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had his authority to engage in the activity regulated by the board revoked or suspended by any other state, agency or authority for reasons consistent with this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or failed to comply with provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or failed to comply with the provisions of any act or regulation administered by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incapable for medical or other good cause of discharging functions consistent with public health, safety and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incapable, for medical or any other good cause, of discharging the functions of a licensee in a manner consistent with the public's health, safety and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presently engaged in drug or alcohol use likely to impair ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is presently engaged in drug or alcohol use that is likely to impair the ability to practice the profession or occupation with reasonable skill and safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed or dispensed controlled dangerous substances indiscriminately or without good cause, or where the applicant or holder knew or should have known that the substances were to be used for unauthorized consumption or distribution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted an unlicensed person to perform acts requiring licensure or aided and abetted unlicensed practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an unlicensed person or entity to perform an act for which a license or certificate of registration or certification is required by the board, or aided and abetted an unlicensed person or entity in performing such an act

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must have graduated from a legally incorporated professional school or college in good standing and completed the same post-graduate training requirements as domestic graduates
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: a diploma from some legally incorporated professional school or college of the United States, Canada or other foreign country, which school or college, in the opinion of the board, was in good standing at the time of the issuance of the diploma, or (b) a license conferring the full right to practice all of the branches of medicine and surgery in some foreign country

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: at least two years of post-graduate training in an accredited program and has signed a contract for a third year of post-graduate training in an accredited program

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Schedule II controlled dangerous substances may be prescribed through telemedicine only after initial in-person examination and subsequent in-person visit required every three months, except for stimulants prescribed to minors under 18 with parental consent and interactive real-time audio and video
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The prescription of Schedule II controlled dangerous substances through the use of telemedicine or telehealth shall be authorized only after an initial in-person examination of the patient, as provided by regulation, and a subsequent in-person visit with the patient shall be required every three months for the duration of time that the patient is being prescribed the Schedule II controlled dangerous substance. However, the provisions of this subsection shall not apply, and the in-person examination or review of a patient shall not be required, when a health care provider is prescribing a stimulant which is a Schedule II controlled dangerous substance for use by a minor patient under the age of 18, provided that the health care provider is using interactive, real-time, two-way audio and video technologies when treating the patient and the health care provider has first obtained written consent for the waiver of these in-person examination requirements from the minor patient's parent or guardian.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require any board licensee, permit holder or registered or certified person to submit to an assessment of skills to determine whether the board licensee, permit holder or registered or certified person can continue to practice with reasonable skill and safety
